reasons.C: Closest to the passage's rhapsodic, reader-addressing movement: imperatives ('Go next into'), rhetorical questions, piled clauses and an exclamatory close; the tacked-on 'verily' tips slightly toward imitation but the enthusiasm and period cadence fit.
reasons.B: Right period diction, dashes and semicolon-linked periodic sentences, but its stance is dry, comic irony (coaches through holes, wet Mondays, rent-day) rather than the passage's warm, exclamatory longing; no exclamations or direct questions.
